messages:
maria: Heads-up — we saw a cluster of short 429 spikes for multiple orgs around 18:30 UTC, looks like soft quota bump hitting per-org token window.

dan: Are these sustained or short bursts? Any per-key amplification?

maria: Mostly short, 10-60s spikes, but repeated for some heavy customers. Per-key rate shows repeated attempts from the same API key. Could be retry storms from their client.

tess: @cs FYI — ticketing those customers now, want to coordinate before we throttle. Which signals should we surface in the runbook?

raj: @oncall checking graphs now. Grafana panel shows per-org 429 rate and short-window moving avg.

maria: Proposed change: add a "softlimit_warning" alert that fires at 70% of quota for 5m with mute rule for <3 distinct keys or if total tokens < 50k. Keeps noisy one-off bursts from paging.

dan: Love soft warnings. Can we add dedup by org + 5min rolling unique keys > 3 to escalate? Also attach sample query:

```query
sum by (org) (increase(api_429_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum by (org) (increase(api_requests_total{env="prod"}[5m])) > 0.02
```

maria: Example Grafana alert block I tested:

```yaml
conditions:
  - evaluator: { type: gt, params: [0.02] }
  - reducer: { type: avg }
for: 5m
annotations:
  severity: warning
  playbook: "/runbooks/softlimit-warning.md"
```

tess: For CS we'd like the alert to include top 3 keys and a sample recent request id so we can reach out quickly.

raj: Oncall prefers alerts not page on warning, only slack #eng-sre and CS. Paging threshold at 90% and sustained 10m.

lina: Product: include a small "why this fired" note in console (UX) so customers see early warning in their dashboard and can self-mitigate.

maria: Agree. Ops note: add suppression rule for "single-key high retries" that marks as transient unless repeat in 30m.

dan: I'll make a PR to the alert rules + add the unique_key count logic. Will add test panels to staging.

tess: After PR lands, CS will update the customer-facing runbook and auto-message templates.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the runbook snippet and paste final alert JSON here when ready :thumbsup:

alert-bot: Deployment started for alert-rule/update-1803457000 by dan

dan: Deployed to staging. cc @raj for verification.

raj: Verified suppression working in staging; no pages for short bursts. Logs:

```text
[1803456990] org=acme key=k-123 retried=8 window=30s 429_rate=0.11
```

tess: Marking this as "runbook: needs review" and scheduling a quick sync with CS tomorrow.

maria: Closing the thread — followups in the PR comments.
